page.layout: One page of running text, in one column. No marginal notes. Page number 46 at the head, centred. A narrow strip of mirrored letters at the right edge is show-through and is left out.

main_text.p: propositum, ad id valere contendunt: ut eos præscierit, vel prædestinârit, vel proposuerit eligere, qui fuerunt credituri. Quis vero sensus sit, mox clarius ita dicit: Illam præ-scientiam sic accipiunt; ut propter fidem futu-ram intelligendi sint præsciti, &c.

Denique, eodem modo rejecisse eos orthodoxam Augustini explicationem ex Scripturâ; quia nullus Patrũ ita, sed aliter intellexerint dictâ[?] Pauli: docet Profper ibidem. Cùm contra eos scripta beatitudinis tuæ, (Augustini,) validissimis & innumeris testimoniis divinarum Scriptu-rarum instructa; proferimus: &c. obstinatiõne suam vetustate defendunt: ut ea, quæ de Epi-stolâ Pauli, Romanis scribentis, ad manifesta-tionem divinæ gratiæ, prævenientis electo-rum merita, coferuntur; à nullo unquâ Ecclesiasticorum ita esse intellecta, ut nunc sentiun-tur, affirment.

Potéstne oculus oculo, manus manui, ovum ovo similius esse, quàm sunt hactenus à Remonstranti-bus dicta veteribus illis? Etsi ergo Soci-nianos, Pelagianos, aut Massilienses, dicere non possumus Chrysostomum, Ambrosium, alios,

page.notes: Quotation marks (») printed at the start of each line of the Prosper quotation are typographic and left out. Words in the scan that were hard to read: "dictâ" (accent over a, marked [?]). Long s is rendered as s throughout. Possible printing error: "propofuerit" (long s), normalised to "proposuerit".
